Depth-corrected car positions fit approximately constant acceleration from rest of 5 m/s², giving v(1)=5.
The fitted car acceleration is approximately 5 m/s² from rest, giving v(2)=10.

Measured the transverse wheel-to-wheel span with perspective and car-depth correction.
Measured the roof height above wheel-bottom level using the depth-corrected scale.
Fitted the car's depth-corrected displacement over time and compared its acceleration with the forklift's known 2 m/s².
